digest.component_or_area: live external LLM test integration (provider matrix guard)
propositions: The resolver canonicalizes openai model specs to 'openai-chat:' qualifier but the live external test tier's provider name comparisons and credential lookup still expect the literal 'openai' family name, causing guard false positives and live test skips.

The unit-tier matrix gate (_MODEL_QUALIFIER_BY_PROVIDER) was updated to map qualifiers to provider families in commit 8f4c5fdb0d3 but the live external tier's credential map and guard comparisons were not updated as required consumers.

tests/external/_live_llm.py's _PROVIDER_KEY_ENV lacks 'openai-chat' entry so configured_provider() returns the qualifier instead of the family, causing credential_present() to fail and live_llm_ready() to return False, skipping all openai-arm live tests.

The guard at test_provider_matrix_live.py line 88 asserts resolved specs match REBAR_EXPECTED_LLM_PROVIDER='openai' literally but receives 'openai-chat' from the resolver, failing despite the arm running the correct provider family.

A family->qualifier mapping (_PROVIDER_FAMILY_BY_QUALIFIER) must be added to the live external tier to make configured_provider(), credential lookups, and guard assertions agree on the provider family name independent of the resolved qualifier.
